createrancher.ponder.mechanical_herder.h: Moving Animals with the Mechanical Herder
createrancher.ponder.mechanical_herder.t: Mechanical Herders pick up animals and carry them to a drop-off position
Sneak and Right-Click a block while holding the Mechanical Herder to select the drop-off position
Then place the Mechanical Herder within 7 blocks of it
Its search area is on the side facing away from you when you place it
The drop-off position has to be outside of the search area
Give it rotational power to get it working
It reaches down and grabs an animal with its suction cup...
...and carries them over to the drop-off position
It's as tall as a fence, so it can be used in the perimeter of an animal pen
createrancher.ponder.mechanical_herder_f: Choosing What the Mechanical Herder Picks Up
Right-Click the Herder with an empty hand to choose what it picks up
Filter for a mob by name, or leave it empty for any mob
Then choose whether it picks up babies, adults or both
If set to baby cows, it takes the calf and leaves the grown cows and the pig alone
The search area can be 3x3x3, 5x3x5 or 7x3x7
Sizes that would cover the drop-off position can't be selected
createrancher.ponder.mechanical_feeder.h: Breeding Animals with the Mechanical Feeder
createrancher.ponder.mechanical_feeder.t: Mechanical Feeders feed animals the food they breed with
Right-Click a depot, belt or other container while holding the Mechanical Feeder to make it the item pickup point
Then place the Mechanical Feeder within 5 blocks of it
It feeds animals in a 7x3x7 area around it
Once powered, it feeds adults that are ready to breed, but only when they have a partner nearby
The pair then breeds as usual
If no pair is ready then it will wait for two animals to be available, holding on to any food it has already picked up
Right-Click it with an empty hand to take back what it's holding
It also feeds Alfalfa Pellets to any animal that can eat them, whether or not they are ready to breed
Once an animal has digested its pellet, it drops Dung and is ready for another
A redstone signal pauses the Mechanical Feeder
createrancher.ponder.mechanical_fisher.t: Sneak and Right-Click water while holding the Mechanical Fisher to set its fishing spot
The fishing spot is the top of the water, which needs open air above it
Then place the Mechanical Fisher within 16 blocks of it
Power it with a cogwheel beside it, how fast it turns makes no difference
Right-Click it with a Fishing Net to load it
It flings the net out onto the water at its fishing spot...
...and waits for a bite just like a fishing rod
Then it hauls the net back in with 1 to 4 catches
Like a player thrown Fishing Net, it only catches treasure loot when the net has the Treasure Hunter enchantment
Right-Click it with an empty hand to collect the catch
Funnels and hoppers can take the catch out too, and put new nets in
It only casts the net while it has room for 4 catches, and each haul uses the net's durability until it breaks
Sneak and Right-Click the Mechanical Fisher with an empty hand to take the net back off, even while it's out on the water
A redstone signal pauses the Mechanical Fisher
createrancher.ponder.item_grate_belts.te: Item Grates can be placed over flat belt segments that have no shaft through them
Players and mobs can stand and walk on grates without being moved by the belt below
Items dropped onto a grate will fall through onto the belt beneath to be transported
Sneak and Right-Click a grate with an empty hand to take it back off the belt
Right-Click a grate on a belt with a copper, iron or brass nugget to plate it with that metal
createrancher.ponder.item_grate_grills.t: Right-Click a campfire with an Item Grate to turn it into a grill
Up to 9 items can cook on a grill at once, Right-Click it with them or drop them onto it
Once they're done, they pop off the top
Soul campfires and cauldrons of water or lava can have a grate placed on them too
Over a campfire, items are smoked
Over a soul campfire, items are haunted
Over a full cauldron of lava, items are smelted
Over a full cauldron of water, items are washed
...but only while something heats it from beneath: lava, magma blocks, fire, campfires, or blaze burners will do the trick
Funnels can put items onto a grill, or take finished ones off it
While something is taking items out of a grill, finished items wait for it instead of popping off the top of the grill
Hoppers and chutes beneath a grill take finished items out of it too
A belt running into the side of a grill slides items onto its grate
Once they're done, they slide off the far side onto the next belt
Anything the grill can't process slides straight across
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_1: Augers placed end to end join into one column
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_2: The column can be spun from either end. Like belts, Augers do not consume stress
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_3: When the end of an Auger column faces an inventory, it can pull items directly out of it...
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_5: Items can be input at any point along the side of the Auger
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_6: Items inside the Auger will move upwards as the screw inside spins
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_7: At the top of the column, items will collect to be taken out
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_8: Add an output anywhere on the side of the Auger to remove items
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_9: Spin the Auger the other direction to move items downwards
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_10: Placing an Auger against the side of another Auger extends the column diagonally
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_11: The Auger column can be extended diagonally or turned upright again
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_12: Items and rotation will move smoothly between diagonal and vertical Augers
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_13: Augers can also be placed horizontally
createrancher.ponder.auger.text_14: Like the vertical Augers, the direction items move in is controlled by the rotation direction
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_1: The Smart Depot works like a Brass Funnel and a Depot in one block
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_2: Placed above an inventory, it pulls items out of it, like Brass Funnel facing up would...
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_3: ...but instead of throwing the item out as an entity, it puts them on top of itself
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_4: Items wait on top until they're taken, by hand or by machines, and then it pulls up the next items
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_5: Like a Brass Funnel, the value panel on its sides sets how many items it takes at a time
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_6: Using an item on the filter slot makes it take only matching items
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_7: Placed while sneaking, it works the other way: whatever is set on its top goes into the inventory below
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_8: Its filter then decides which items go into the inventory; anything else stays on top
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot.text_9: A Wrench switches it between pulling items up and putting them in, the arrow on its side shows which mode it is in
createrancher.ponder.smart_depot_process: Like a Regular Depot, machines can process the items on its top
The Smart Depot waits while a machine processes the item on its top...
...and deposits the resulting crafted item into the inventory below as soon as it's made, unless the machine will work on it again
Anything no machine can work on goes straight in
The same goes for any other machines that can process items on the top of a Depot
createrancher.ponder.livestock_drain.tex: Livestock Drains collect fluid from the animals standing on them at a rate of 2mb/t per animal
Different fluids can be in a drain at once, each sharing whatever space is available
A brown mooshroom that has eaten a flower gives one serving of that flower's suspicious stew, then mushroom stew again
Animals from other mods work too, giving whatever fluid they would give to a bowl or a bucket
Animals anywhere in the block above a drain can be processed, this means carpet or slabs can be placed above the drain
createrancher.ponder.livestock_drain_sto: A Livestock Drain holds 1500mb of fluid
Drains placed side by side at the same height connect; they combine their contents and their capacity
Pumps and pipes on its sides or underneath can take fluid out of all of the connected drains
They can pump fluid in too
Players can also use buckets to manually fill or empty it
createrancher.ponder.liquid_blaze_burner: Like a Blaze Burner, the Liquid Blaze Burner heats whatever is above it, but it burns liquid fuels instead of items
Fuel can be poured in from a bucket...
Lava keeps the blaze heated; some fuels, like Biofuel, superheat it
createrancher.ponder.shared.spout_bucket: Spouts can be filled or emptied with a bucket
createrancher.ponder.shared.spout_pipes: Pipes can also be used to supply it with fluids
Shearing Animals with the Mechanical Shearer
The Mechanical Shearer is able to shear nearby animals
It reaches any animal in a 7x3x7 area around it
Once powered, it shears them and the items that come off fall onto the ground
Any animal that is able to be sheared can interact with the Mechanical Shearer: sheep, mooshrooms, snow golems, and modded animals too
Animals with nothing to shear are left alone
If a funnel, hopper, chute, or other block that pulls from inventories is connected to the Mechanical Shearer, what it shears goes into that instead of falling onto the ground
createrancher.ponder.tag.ranching.descri: Machines that look after your animals
